27197-modern-spiritualism.title: Modern Spiritualism
27197-modern-spiritualism.creator: Unknown
27197-modern-spiritualism.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The Bible in the plainest terms, declares that in the last days malign influences will be let loose upon the world; false pretensions will be urged upon the minds of men; and deceptions, backed up by preternatural signs and wonders, will develop to such a degree of strength, that, if it were possible, they would deceive the very elect.

60144-under-six-flags-the-story-of-texas.title: The Story Of Texas
60144-under-six-flags-the-story-of-texas.creator: M. E. M. Davis
60144-under-six-flags-the-story-of-texas.description: A book by M. E. M. Davis. Again, its vast extent of territory and the ease with which its rich lands were acquired seemed to adapt Texas peculiarly to those communistic and utopian experiments which have been the delight of the visionary in every age of the world’s progress. A number of these have been tried upon its soil. The result has been to give a varied and original coloring to the shifting scenes.

arxiv-2101-10374.title: DAHash: Distribution Aware Tuning of Password Hashing Costs
arxiv-2101-10374.creator: Wenjie Bai, Jeremiah Blocki
arxiv-2101-10374.description: Abstract An attacker who breaks into an authentication server and steals all of the cryptographic password hashes is able to mount an offline-brute force attack against each user’s password. Offline brute-force attacks against passwords are increasingly commonplace and the danger is amplified by the well documented human tendency to select low-entropy password and/or reuse these passwords across multiple accounts.

arxiv-2109-07648.title: Meteor : A Dense, Heterogeneous, and Unstructured Traffic Dataset With Rare Behaviors
arxiv-2109-07648.creator: Rohan Chandra, Xijun Wang, Mridul Mahajan, Rahul Kala, Rishitha Palugulla, Chandrababu Naidu, Alok Jain, Dinesh Manocha, Dataset, Code, and Video at https://gamma.umd.edu/meteor
arxiv-2109-07648.description: Abstract We present a new traffic dataset, Meteor , which captures traffic patterns and multi-agent driving behaviors in unstructured scenarios. Meteor consists of more than 1000 1000 one-minute videos, over 2 2 million annotated frames with bounding boxes and GPS trajectories for 16 16 unique agent categories, and more than 13 13 million bounding boxes for traffic agents.

arxiv-2211-12817.title: Reason from Context with Self-supervised Learning
arxiv-2211-12817.creator: Xiao Liu, Ankur Sikarwar, Gabriel Kreiman, Zenglin Shi, Mengmi Zhang
arxiv-2211-12817.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning (SSL) learns to capture discriminative visual features useful for knowledge transfers. To better accommodate the object-centric nature of current downstream tasks such as object recognition and detection, various methods have been proposed to suppress contextual biases or disentangle objects from contexts.

arxiv-2310-13740.title: Cosmoglobe DR1. III. First full-sky model of polarized synchrotron emission from all WMAP and Planck LFI data
arxiv-2310-13740.creator: D. J. Watts, U. Fuskeland, R. Aurlien, A. Basyrov, L. A. Bianchi, M. Brilenkov, H. K. Eriksen, K. S. F. Fornazier, M. Galloway, E. Gjerløw, B. Hensley, L. T. Hergt, D. Herman, H. Ihle, K. Lee, J. G. S. Lunde, S. K. Nerval, M. San, N. O. Stutzer, H. Thommesen, I. K. Wehus
arxiv-2310-13740.description: Abstract We present the first model of full-sky polarized synchrotron emission that is derived from all WMAP and Planck LFI frequency maps. The basis of this analysis is the set of end-to-end reprocessed Cosmoglobe Data Release 1 sky maps presented in a companion paper, which have significantly lower instrumental systematics than the legacy products from each experiment.

arxiv-2402-18408.title: Multimode Interferometers: an Analytical Method for Determining the Accumulated Phase Difference Between the Fundamental Mode and One Arbitrary High-Order Mode
arxiv-2402-18408.creator: Yuri Hayashi Isayama a
arxiv-2402-18408.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuri Hayashi Isayama a. In multimode interferometers, the interaction between several modes brings a high level of complexity to the interpretation of its light patterns. With recent advances, it is possible to selectively excite only a couple of modes inside the device. This paper presents an analytical method for determining the phase difference between two propagating modes in the multimode interferometer, in an effort to simplify the usage and expand the range of applications for this type of optical devices.

The US government retains and the pu
arxiv-2404-14312.creator: Steffen Schotthöfer, M. Paul Laiu, Martin Frank, Cory D. Hauck
arxiv-2404-14312.description: Abstract The main challenge of large-scale numerical simulation of radiation transport is the high memory and computation time requirements of discretization methods for kinetic equations. In this work, we derive and investigate a neural network-based approximation to the entropy closure method to accurately compute the solution of the multi-dimensional moment system with a low memory footprint and competitive computational time.

arxiv-2407-11895.title: OmniBind: Large-scale Omni Multimodal Representation via Binding Spaces
arxiv-2407-11895.creator: Zehan Wang 1 Ziang Zhang 1 Hang Zhang 1 Luping Liu 1 Rongjie Huang 1
arxiv-2407-11895.description: Abstract Recently, human-computer interaction with various modalities has shown promising applications, like GPT-4o and Gemini. Given the foundational role of multimodal joint representation in understanding and generation pipelines, high-quality omni joint representations would be a step toward co-processing more diverse multimodal information.

arxiv-2412-00279.title: Optimal local storage policy based on stochastic intensities and its large scale behavior
arxiv-2412-00279.creator: Matias Carrasco, Andres Ferragut, Fernando Paganini
arxiv-2412-00279.description: Abstract In this paper, we analyze the optimal management of local memory systems, using the tools of stationary point processes. We provide a rigorous setting of the problem, building upon recent work, and characterize the optimal causal policy that maximizes the hit probability.

arxiv-2509-19908.title: Lyndon Word Transduction to Improve the Efficiency of Computing Chen–Fliess Series
arxiv-2509-19908.creator: W. Steven Gray, Fatima Raza, Lance Berlin, Luis A. Duffaut Espinosa
arxiv-2509-19908.description: Abstract . The class of input-output systems representable as Chen–Fliess series arises often in control theory. One well known drawback of this representation, however, is that the iterated integrals which appear in these series are algebraically related by the shuffle product.

pmc-10537792.title: Modulation of Macrophage Redox and Apoptotic Processes to Leishmania infantum during Coinfection with the Tick-Borne Bacteria Borrelia burgdorferi
pmc-10537792.creator: Danielle Pessôa-Pereira, Breanna M Scorza, Karen I Cyndari, Erin A Beasley, Christine A Petersen, Jeffrey Jon Shaw, Abhay Satoskar
pmc-10537792.description: Canine leishmaniosis (CanL) is a zoonotic disease caused by protozoan Leishmania infantum. Dogs with CanL are often coinfected with tick-borne bacterial pathogens, including Borrelia burgdorferi in the United States. These coinfections have been causally associated with hastened disease progression and mortality. However, the specific cellular mechanisms of how coinfections affect microbicidal responses against L. infantum are unknown.

pmc-11380731.title: Retention in Care Among People Living with HIV in Nigeria: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-11380731.creator: John O Olawepo, Katherine O'Brien, Julia Papasodoro, Philip E Coombs, Neha Singh, Shubhi Gupta, Aarushi Bhan, Babayemi O Olakunde, Echezona E Ezeanolue
pmc-11380731.description: Background: In 2021, Nigeria had an estimated 1.9 million people living with the human immunodeficiency virus (PLHIV) and 1.7 million (90%) on antiretroviral therapy (ART). Study Design: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Methods: This meta-analysis followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines. We searched PubMed, Embase, PsychINFO, CINAHL, Global Index Medicus, and Cochrane Library.

pmc-11603290.description: The goal of this study is to develop a non-invasive approach for early detection of oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) using our established mouse model that faithfully recapitulates the human disease. pmc-11638784.title: Investigation of Antibacterial Coatings Based on Chitosan/Polyacrylic Acid/Chlorhexidine for Orthopedic Implants
pmc-11638784.creator: Balzhan Savdenbekova, Ayazhan Seidulayeva, Aruzhan Sailau, Zhanar Bekissanova, Dilafruz Rakhmatullayeva, Ardak Jumagaziyeva
pmc-11638784.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Antibacterial coatings on model silicon wafers and implants, based on chitosan (CHI), poly(acrylic acid) (PAA), and the antibacterial agent chlorhexidine digluconate (CHX), were obtained using a layer-by-layer assembly method. The surface roughness and 2D and 3D images of the surfaces of CHI/PAA/CHX coatings obtained from different pH assemblies were investigated by atomic force microscopy, revealing that pH 6 enabled optimal inclusion of CHX in the multilayer film.

pmc-12433717.title: Trauma-Induced Unilateral Progression of Sclerosis in a Patient With Limited Cutaneous Systemic Sclerosis
pmc-12433717.creator: Claudia Lee, Neha Garg, Stephanie Mengden-Koon, Nicole Fett
pmc-12433717.description: Systemic sclerosis is an autoimmune connective tissue disease, which is characterized by immune dysregulation and progressive sclerosis of the skin with variable internal organ involvement. Exogenous triggers such as physical trauma are documented as a potential precipitating factor for systemic sclerosis; however, the condition typically presents with bilateral skin changes.

pmc-12565713.title: Microstructure and Properties of Binderless μWC Obtained Using the Electroconsolidation Method
pmc-12565713.creator: Edvin Hevorkian, Waldemar Samociuk, Miroslaw Rucki, Zbigniew Krzysiak, Daniel Pieniak, Volodymyr Nerubatskyi, Volodymyr Chyshkala, Serhii Lytovchenko, Leszek Chalko, Dmitrij Morozow, Jacek Caban, Vitalii Kulich, Mattia Biesuz
pmc-12565713.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This paper contributes to the knowledge of binderless tungsten carbide (WC), which attracts the attention of many engineers and scientists for its superior properties, but its application is limited due to difficulties with the consolidation of initial powders. In the present study, the microstructure and mechanical properties of binderless WC, sintered with the electroconsolidation technique from the initial powder of a grain size of 100–200 nm, were investigated.

pmc-12787258.title: Disruption of the Placenta–Brain Axis in Transgenic Mice Lacking Serotonin Transporter (SERT) in Trophoblast Cells
pmc-12787258.creator: David T. Ellenberger, Zhen Lyu, Rosalind T. B. Herrington, Jessica A. Kinkade, Gustavo W. Leone, Ji Ying Sze, Nathan J. Bivens, R. Frank Baker, R. Michael Roberts, Trupti Joshi, Cheryl S. Rosenfeld
pmc-12787258.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) are commonly prescribed to pregnant women experiencing depression. Such drugs, however, might adversely affect placenta and fetal brain development. Parietal trophoblast giant cells (pTGCs) in the mouse placenta are postulated to internalize maternal serotonin (5-HT) via transport through SERT, encoded by Slc6a4, and to provide the initial source of 5-HT to the emerging brain via the placental–brain axis. Genetic deletion of Slc6a4 in pTGCs has been hypothesized to impact placental and fetal brain development.
